_role: The disposition of every artifact that is CITED by a document here and ABSENT from this ref. Read by check_artifacts ([K1]/[K2]).
_why: ⛔ 'CITED AND ABSENT' IS AN OBSERVATION, NOT A GAP, AND READING IT AS A GAP COST A 90-MINUTE CI RUN ON A RETIRED THREAD (2026-08-05). It has THREE meanings and they license OPPOSITE actions: `elsewhere` says go and fetch it, `expected` says go and run something, `withdrawn` says go and delete the citation. Guessing between them wastes either compute or a fact.

⚠ THE THIRD ONE IS THE ONE THAT GETS FORGOTTEN, AND HERE IS EXACTLY HOW. [K1] was written the same day 24 artifacts were found stranded on the `modalities-cache` branch, so its message named branch drift and 'never run' — the two causes in front of the author — and stopped. It then reported `valb-triangle-chem.json` that way. That artifact is the chemistry PRE-gate for a lane which CLOSED on 2026-07-30 with all four legs landed; the roadmap said so in a struck-through row. The check inherited its author's blind spot and reported it with total confidence.

⭐ SO THE FIX IS NOT A LONGER MESSAGE, IT IS A REFUSAL TO LET THE CHOICE BE SKIPPED. An artifact reaches this file only by being cited and absent, so the set is naturally tiny and self-limiting — and [K1] enumerates anything that is missing from it. It cannot silently grow.

⚠ EVERY ENTRY IS A CHECKED CLAIM. [K2] requires the evidence field its disposition demands plus a real `why`, and rejects one-liners: `elsewhere` must argue a second copy would be HARMFUL, `expected` must name the work that is open, `withdrawn` must name what closed it.

⭐ [K1] also now SURFACES the roadmap's own closure convention — a struck-through row followed by ✅ CLOSED — as evidence beside any absent artifact whose name it matches. Evidence for the person deciding, never a verdict the check reaches on its own.

⭐ 2026-08-05, LATER THE SAME DAY — valb-triangle-chem.json was REMOVED from this file, and the removal is the point. LANE-9 now carries it in `produces[]` with `produced: false`, so its disposition is DERIVED from the lane's state rather than asserted here. A written entry that duplicates a derived one is a second home for one fact and would win silently if it drifted, which is the same shadowing bug the link baseline had. [K2] now errors on any such duplicate. This register is for artifacts NO lane owns.
